facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports Mozambique's Electronic Transactions Law is being implemented, with the first licences to digital operators issued under it on 2026-06-08.

The report says the Electronic Transactions Law has supporting regulations that set up registration, supervision and licensing of intermediate electronic service providers and digital platform operators; no regulation is dated.

INTIC's board president said 19 licences had been issued to intermediate electronic service providers and digital platform operators out of about 170 registered companies under evaluation, at a ceremony in Maputo on 2026-06-08.
